name: f_bj_lepesek
text: The left sign is a small 'Classic BLACK JACK' logo: red script 'Classic' at its top-left, then red block letters 'BLACK' on the first line and 'JACK' on the second line, on light blue tiles with a golden outline. name: f_helps
text: Keep the small yellow-green header at the top exactly as it is.
